ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of high-intensity pixels (approx. 75% of fluke area) interrupted by localized low-intensity linear patterns; high global contrast against a near-white background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Linear low-intensity features densely distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes; dark vertical focal band at the central fluke-peduncle axis; low-intensity pigmentation concentrated at the outer margins of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; vertex depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular boundary with high-frequency pixel amplitude variations; numerous jagged peaks and valleys concentrated along the central and superior trailing edge segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve along leading edges, transitioning to sharp distal tips; trailing edge follows a complex multi-point concave-to-convex trajectory towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) concentrated at the outermost distal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Ubiquitous distribution of non-aligned, low-intensity linear pixel strings (rake marks) intersecting across more than 80% of the visible ventral field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring from multi-directional linear abrasions and irregular tissue loss/bio-accumulation at the distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high density of overlapping parallel rake mark sets, covering nearly the entire visible ventral surface.
